company.name: Tombeely
company.shortDescription: Tombeely is an E-commerce Marketplace that specializes in car parts and accessories.
company.description:
Tombeely is an E-commerce Marketplace that specializes in car parts and accessories. This platform is made to connect auto parts merchants with the customers to reduce the aftermarket car parts shopping hassle, as well as providing huge varieties to customers with installation options through a network of service centers and mechanics with warranty. It also provides on-site maintenance.

It is based in Egypt and was founded in 2017.
